owner.invariant: One exact carry-forward proposal version, including the exact successor examination, plan and period identities, requires independent approval and an atomic execution claim before successor writes; the claim pins that version against revision. The recoverable private process coordinates existing source owners and stores exact completion proof.
owner.boundary: ProgramRollover owns the approved carry-forward intent and pins NextExaminationId, NextTypeIIPlanId and NextPeriodId. An atomic execution claim closes the revise-versus-execute race. Private ProgramRolloverExecutionProcess coordinates the existing readiness, examination, Type I baseline/outcome, system description, TypeIIPlan and TypeIIPeriod owner lifecycles without owning their facts; it stores exact successor receipts. Prior proposal history and successor acknowledgements are not business aggregate state.

commands.name: ProposeProgramRollover
commands.rule: NextExaminationId is a required, nonempty successor identity, distinct from SourceExaminationId, frozen in the exact version and approval hash together with next period/plan IDs and dates.

commands.name: ClaimProgramRolloverExecution
commands.rule: Internal process command; no public route. Atomically require status approved, exact ExpectedRevision, exact current ApprovedVersion/content SHA256 and latest actual ProgramRolloverApproved fact. Derive and copy immutable approval actor/role/time into ProgramRolloverExecutionClaimView; store CommandId and ClaimedAt; transition status to execution_claimed in one append. Exact retry only same command+tuple; reject all later revisions/rejections/claims. Event actor attribution retains the approving member; process identity is separately recorded in private process state.

stages.rule: Require actual current TypeIEntryDecisionRecorded for this tenant/program with outcome approve or approve_with_exceptions before creating the successor Type I examination. This decision remains owned by ReadinessAssessment.

A personal authorized actor creates exact NextExaminationId through CreateExaminationEngagement under ExaminationEngagement rules. Verify actual ExaminationEngagementOpened, exact tenant/program/examination identity and approved next-period dates; examination owner retains its own lifecycle.

Wait for actual TypeIBaselineFrozen on exact NextExaminationId; capture exact baseline ID/hash and complete source manifest. Require actual AuditOutcomeRecorded with status recorded, scope type_i, source kind auditor, same examination and exact baseline ID/hash. Require actual SystemDescriptionApproved and SystemDescriptionBound to same examination, type_i_baseline purpose, exact baseline ID and a system-description version present in the frozen baseline. These facts remain owned by their existing aggregates.

A personal authorized actor authors complete TypeIIPlanContent under TypeIIPlan source validation, with exact NextExaminationId, exact Type I baseline/outcome/system-description IDs/hashes, NextTypeIIPlanId and approved period dates. Freeze actual proposal version/content hash; do not invent missing sources, controls, findings or required changes.

Every pinned rollover record and commitment has exactly one explicit plan destination or justified nonrepresentation consistent with approved disposition; preserve exact source/version/hash; reject omissions, duplicates, mismatches and unsupported conversions; freeze complete mapping manifest/hash privately.

Wait for actual TypeIIPlanReviewed on exact current frozen version/hash. Reviewer differs from proposer. approve advances; changes_requested loops through human revision, target-owner source validation and a newly frozen exhaustive mapping. reject terminates as failed.

Wait for actual TypeIIPlanApproved on same exact current version/hash whose review outcome is approve; approver differs from proposer and reviewer and satisfies owner rules. Approved plan is immutable.

Only after actual approved plan proof, submit exact NextPeriodId, NextTypeIIPlanId, NextExaminationId and dates from the claimed rollover. Verify TypeIIPeriodOpeningAccepted and original 202; accepted is pending.

Complete only on actual ObservationPeriodStarted chain linked to immutable opening intent, operation root/result, exact rollover claim and IDs, actual examination open fact, Type I entry decision, frozen baseline/hash/source manifest, auditor outcome/hash, approved+bound description fact/version, final plan proposal/revision/review/approval facts and hashes, exhaustive mapping manifest/hash, period/range and calendar authorization ID/generation. Store verified proof references privately; never emit ProgramNextPeriodCreated.

requiredProofContract.proofGate: Verify actual approved rollover fact and atomic claim pinning version/content hash/approval actor-role-time. Rollover content pins NextExaminationId, NextTypeIIPlanId, NextPeriodId and dates. Observe actual Type I entry approval; actual human-created successor examination; exact frozen Type I baseline, auditor outcome and approved/bound system-description version; human-authored source-validated TypeIIPlan; exhaustive carry-forward mapping; independent review and executive approval. Then submit exact period start. Pending admission is not completion; require actual started chain with immutable opening intent, native root/result, exact source and target facts/hashes, period/range and calendar authorization ID/generation.
requiredProofContract.mappingManifest: Each rollover record and commitment maps exactly once to a TypeIIPlan destination or justified nonrepresentation consistent with approved disposition; exact source/version/hash, complete frozen manifest/hash; reject omissions, duplicates, mismatch and unsupported conversion.

requiredTypedStageProofSets.role: exact rollover version and approval tuple pinned before successor work
requiredTypedStageProofSets.requiredVerification: same tenant/program/rollover, version/content hash and approver identity/role/time; claim content binds NextExaminationId, NextTypeIIPlanId, NextPeriodId and dates.
actual current approved/approved_with_exceptions readiness decision; actual examination event same tenant/program and exact NextExaminationId, with approved next dates.

requiredTypedStageProofSets.role: complete Type I prerequisite source chain
requiredTypedStageProofSets.requiredVerification: same NextExaminationId; frozen baseline ID/hash and complete manifest; recorded auditor Type I outcome bound to exact baseline/hash; approved description version exists in baseline and is actually bound for same examination, type_i_baseline purpose and baseline ID.

requiredTypedStageProofSets.role: complete human-authored successor plan and independent governance
requiredTypedStageProofSets.requiredVerification: same NextTypeIIPlanId and NextExaminationId; current version hash; baseline/outcome/description source IDs and hashes exact; dates match rollover; complete exhaustive carry-forward mapping; reviewer and executive approver distinct from proposer and each other; actual facts.
exact NextPeriodId, NextTypeIIPlanId, NextExaminationId and dates; immutable intent and original 202; pending only.
actual native chain to accepted opening; exact period stream/range and plan ID/version/hash; operation root/result and calendar authorization ID/generation.

requiredProofContract.recoveryContract: Persist before starter checkpoint; retry deterministic exact identities; observe human decisions only through actual typed facts; after lost append reload and verify actual facts. Missing dependencies retry; invalid/mismatched proofs quarantine. Rejection/failure never implies success or release; accepted remains pending, started is complete. A changes_requested plan version loops through an exact revised version and new complete mapping; a rejected plan terminates as failed. Missing Type I prerequisites wait/retry under their exact owners; the process never fabricates a baseline, outcome, description or examination. A changes_requested plan loops to human revision/remapping; explicit reject is terminal failed. An opening rejection is never started.
requiredProofContract.crossOwnerCorrelation: Private process record is rooted in actual ProgramRolloverExecutionClaimed. It verifies every fact on the owner-specific tenant/program/examination/baseline/plan/period stream named by the pinned content. The next plan and period commands repeat exact NextExaminationId/NextTypeIIPlanId/NextPeriodId; mismatched owner identities cannot advance.

effectIdentity.rule: Use an explicitly versioned injective length-prefixed encoding for this new domain; preserve any occupied IDs unchanged; fixed vectors required before activation.

sourceRules: ProgramRollover.Revise currently allows revisions while approved until period_created.

ProgramRolloverContent now pins NextExaminationId as well as NextPeriodId and NextTypeIIPlanId. TypeIIPlan proposal validates a current frozen Type I baseline, exact auditor outcome, approved and baseline-bound system description, controls, owners and carried findings.

The process requires actual TypeIEntryDecisionRecorded, ExaminationEngagementOpened, TypeIBaselineFrozen, AuditOutcomeRecorded, SystemDescriptionApproved and SystemDescriptionBound facts for exact NextExaminationId/baseline before human TypeIIPlan proposal. TypeIIPlan then has proposal, review and approval events; review is independent, executive approver differs from proposer and reviewer.

StartTypeIIObservationPeriod verifies exact current approved plan, admits TypeIIPeriodOpeningAccepted with fixed 202; TypeIIRangeProcess later emits ObservationPeriodStarted after calendar acquire/apply/settle.
ObservationPeriodStarted includes immutable Change, Operation provenance, CalendarAuthorizationId, CalendarGeneration, FirstResponse, OperationResult and native sequence/header/current content.

boundary.instructions: Is this revised ProgramRollover business/process boundary coherent and complete?

criteria.coherent: Business owner has exact approval plus atomic execution fence; private recoverable process owns mapping/progress/receipts and preserves target owner authority.
criteria.missing_or_wrong: A concrete owner boundary or necessary responsibility remains absent or misplaced.

race.instructions: Does the execution claim fully close the approved-rollover revise/reject/duplicate-execution race?

criteria.true: Atomic expected revision pins exact approved version/hash and approval tuple; all later revisions/rejections/claims conflict; process persists prior to checkpoint.

mapping.instructions: Is the successor-plan handoff safe given the different TypeIIPlanContent schema?

criteria.safe_human_authored: A person authors complete plan under target owner source validation; process freezes actual version/hash; every rollover item maps exactly once or has justified approved-disposition-consistent omission; no implicit synthesis.
criteria.implicit_mapping_gap: Mapping is underspecified, partial or process synthesizes missing plan authority.
criteria.rollover_must_own_plan: Full plan content should be part of rollover aggregate itself.

sequence.instructions: Is the process sequence correct across the actual independent owner workflows?

criteria.correct: Plan proposal then independent review then separate executive approval; exact plan proof gates period opening; 202 remains pending and only actual started period is complete.
criteria.incorrect: Wrong order or missing owner fact.

proof.instructions: Does terminal proof bind exact root intent, every approval, target period and calendar/application result?

criteria.true: Actual typed source chain and immutable content bind claim, plan proposal/review/approval/hash, opening admission, started event, native root/result and calendar authorization/generation.
criteria.false: Any binding is missing or relies on process-carried assertion instead of actual verified fact.

event.instructions: Is retiring ProgramNextPeriodCreated from business event emission correct?

criteria.retire: Yes; exact successor proof references and terminal result live in private process state.
criteria.retain: Business aggregate should emit successor receipt too.
